title: The Howling Pass
text: The wind in the pass howls names: old names, House names, the names of the dead, flung against the rock and thrown back. Now and then, faint but clear, it howls one of yours in a voice you know.

options.label: Shout your names back into the wind, and let it know you are still alive.

outcomes.text: The wind takes them and goes quiet, satisfied. It will keep them for when you are gone.

options.label: The wisest listens for one name in particular, hoping to learn what became of it.

outcomes.text: The name dates from the founding of your Houses. What became of it is not a good story.

options.label: Stop your ears and hurry through, before it calls your own names.

outcomes.text: It howls your names at your backs all the way down.
